[PREFERENCE] User is looking for good brands and models for road bike tires.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended high-end tire options:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Continental Grand Prix 5000: Excellent grip, rolling resistance, and puncture protection.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Vittoria Corsa G2.0: High-performance tire with a unique tread pattern for improved grip and speed.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Michelin Power Competition: Lightweight, responsive tire with excellent grip and puncture resistance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended mid-range tire options:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Specialized Turbo Cotton: High-quality tire designed for speed and comfort.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Schwalbe One: Offers a great balance of grip, speed, and durability.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Hutchinson Fusion 5: Versatile tire suitable for both racing and training.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended budget-friendly tire options:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Continental Ultra Sport III: Reliable, entry-level tire with a good balance of grip and durability.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Kenda Kountach: Budget-friendly option with a comfortable ride and decent grip.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Bontrager R3: Solid choice for those on a budget, offering a good balance of grip and durability.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Factors to consider when choosing a tire:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Width: Wider tires (25-28mm) provide a more comfortable ride, while narrower tires (23mm) are faster but less comfortable.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Tread pattern: Slick tires are faster, while aggressive tread patterns provide better grip in wet conditions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Puncture resistance: Look for tires with built-in puncture protection.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Weight: Lighter tires can improve acceleration and climbing performance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Compatibility: Ensure the tire is compatible with your wheelset and rim type.
